text:
maria (Marketing): Quick sync — we intend to publish the cost/efficiency playbook blog tomorrow at 10:00 PT under embargo. Need PR + social + support + oncall alignment. who can take notes?

sam (PR): I can own reporter list and embargo emails. confirm embargo time is 10:00 PT?

maria (Marketing): Yes, 10:00 PT embargo lift. We send embargoed PR at 09:55 PT. Legal sign-off received last night but see @ellen note.

ellen (Legal): Signed off on the core release. Please remove the line that mentions specific partner names — we have a follow-on quote pending. Otherwise good.

kai (Growth): I'll schedule UTM-tagged links and analytics events. Will queue an early spike alert for ad budgets between 10:00–11:00 PT.

sasha (Design): Creative assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marketing/cost-playbook/v1 — includes OG image, hero, and three social sizes. Want final approval on the hero crop.

maria (Marketing): thanks @sasha. @oliver will you add SEO meta + canonical?

oliver (Content): on it — I'll add meta description and canonical, ensure H1 matches blog title. Also prepping an excerpt for newsletter.

jamal (Product): Product will be on standby in case the new tutorial triggers support tickets. We ran load tests yesterday: Dedicated pool handled 1.8M tokens/min at p95 latency within SLA. No regressions found.

devops-bot: incident: us-west2 spike 07:14 resolved 07:21 — no customer impact.

jamal (Product): good to know. we'll monitor logs closely during publish window. @support-lead please confirm coverage.

support-lead (Support): Confirmed: two engineers 09:30–11:30 PT, one escalation on-call. Slack channel #support will be watched; pager escalation path tested.

sam (PR): Draft embargo email for reporters (will personalize):
```
Hi <name>,
Embargoed until 10:00 PT on 2026-03-24: Redwood Inference is publishing its Cost & Efficiency Playbook, outlining practical optimizations for inference economics. We'd love to share an embargoed copy and arrange a briefing.
Best,
Sam
```

maria (Marketing): nice. Keep the embargo note bold at top. Also: DO NOT include raw benchmark CSVs in the embargoed package — include summarized charts only.

sam (PR): Got it. Who is the executive available for quotes? @jamal?

jamal (Product): I can do a short quote, but we also have an exec quote from our CTO file — @maria can confirm which to use.

maria (Marketing): Use CTO quote for headline, jamal for product detail. I'll paste final quote by EOD.

kai (Growth): Social cadence suggestion: 10:05 PT (announce), 13:00 PT (deep dive thread), 16:00 PT (case study highlight). Will prepare threads and gifs.

sasha (Design): GIFs and short clips ready in the drive under /gifs. Use size 1080x1080 for IG and 1200x675 for X.

sam (PR): Press list preview: TechCrunch, The Information, Venture, Wired, some regional outlets. Will send embargo invites at 09:55 PT. Anyone we should blacklist from embargo?

ell en (Legal): Minor correction: do not send embargo to outlet X; we have separate outreach.

maria (Marketing): trackers: use utm_source=marketing&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cost_playbook. Also append ?ref=press for press links.

oliver (Content): I'll ensure the blog includes a short TL;DR at the top for reporters and a link to the press kit (summaries + images).

support-lead (Support): One quick ask — include a short troubleshooting FAQ in the press kit so support can triage common questions faster.

maria (Marketing): good call. oliver please add a 3-bullet FAQ.

oliver (Content): done, adding now.

sam (PR): timeline recap: 09:30 PT final internal announce to company; 09:55 PT embargo emails to reporters; 10:00 PT blog.live + press release live + social queue starts. I'll ping #marketing and #newswire at each step.

maria (Marketing): final checklist tickbox from my side: publish button at 10:00 PT, tweet thread scheduled, PR sent, support channel staffed, monitoring dashboard link posted. If anything blocks, call me immediately.

devops-bot: reminder: scheduled monitoring probe for the playbook article at 09:59 PT.

sam (PR): I'll also prep an alternate one-line headline for syndication.

maria (Marketing): perfect. thanks everyone. quick emoji check: :rocket: :eyes: :white_check_mark:

sasha (Design): :white_check_mark: creative done

jamal (Product): :eyes: on product ops

support-lead (Support): :white_check_mark: support coverage

maria (Marketing): I'm going to schedule the internal all-hands ping at 09:30 PT. See you tomorrow.
